The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 12031 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 3 August - the folder's feast day. Captioned Dalmat and Favst - Dalmatus and his son Faustus, commemorated together on this day. Dalmatus was abbot of the Dalmatou monastery at Constantinople, this folder's saint, so the joint plate naming him is its hero. The second plate of the day, 12032, is a Kosma.
